annotations.title: French company health check by SIREN (start here)

description: Start here to vet a French company: can I trust it? One call by SIREN returns identity (legal form, NAF activity, age, head office, headcount, active/ceased), current officers, insolvency proceedings (BODACC), legal events of the last 24 months, last accounts filing, factual risk signals and a rule-based verdict green/orange/red/unknown. Use it for supplier/customer due diligence and KYB. If you only know the name, call company_search first to get the SIREN. Official INSEE Sirene, RNE and BODACC data. Price: $0.02 per call, paid in USDC on Base via x402. You are not charged when the call fails or finds nothing.
